phase: Phase 3: File playback in the AudioBus
summary: T6k closes F1. The compatibility helper and own-key checks cover every event-map read, and the inherited-remap regression passes. The scoped scan passes but has a nonblocking false negative when a URL string precedes a built-in call on the same line.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] review-a: tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts:22-29 strips line comments before quoted strings. A line such as `const url = "https://example.test"; Object.hasOwn(events, name);` is truncated at the URL's `//`, so the scan misses the unsupported call. This is a test-tool false negative with no current user-reachable product defect; record it as tech debt.
evidence: F1 withdrawn: src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:125-134 checks ownership for both maps before retaining state, :271-273 checks before request entry lookup, :284-289 checks before current-map lookup, and src/apk3d/audio/chibi.ts:24 uses the shared helper before accepting a Chibi event.

The inherited-remap regression at tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial-r3.test.ts:89-136 passes; it remaps a pending own custom->tap event to an inherited-only custom->tap map and verifies that no stale buffer starts or new fetch follows.
